checks: RW01: classifier distinguishes fireAt−1, fireAt equality, fireAt+1 and SLA−1/equality/+1; classifier equality is separate from dispatch retry eligibility

RW02: restore before fireAt retains online one-shot even when later polled after SLA; startup exactly at/after fireAt recovers once under original root, wait, source and admission without a model call
RW03: missed timer dispatch succeeds strictly before SLA; exact SLA has no retry window and later SLA expires, both durably retire without callback, wake, new admission or replay
RW04: a paused missed-timer callback keeps its ID and cannot dispatch at the original SLA equality, even after a second rebuild
RW05: registered owner identity, root, fireAt, creation time and timer record are immutable at SQLite boundary; ordinary code cannot drift or rebase them
RW06: malformed imported timer rows with plausible shifted fireAt, changed/missing/string seconds or wrong stored kind retire invalid; recovery never reconstructs authority from their plausible delay
RW07: original member permission/role/membership and changed/unknown trusted source authorization/anchor retire missed timer invalid without borrowing newer authority or dispatching a callback
RW08: trusted source authority is checked again before a paused callback is delivered; revocation rejects the existing callback without rebasing wait or retrying model
RW09: a real tool-mediated Action return advances generation; its original holder timer retires invalid rather than waking or satisfying the newer generation

cases.name: actual Action generation returned before timer recovery

scope.composition: actual threaded backend factories, disposable SQLite, deterministic injected provider
scope.recovery: SQLite connection and runtime factory reopen; this file does not prove actual PID or index restart
scope.ownerAuth: local immutable instance owner plus frozen member identity and trusted source authorization; no claim of identical upstream fields
scope.baseline: immutable original row + exact registered seconds/creation/fireAt recovery comparison
scope.sla: missed timer only; classifier allows equality, delivery requires now < original SLA
